# cook-docs

> Rust CLI for automatically generating standardized Markdown documentation from Cooklang (`.cook`) recipes using Go-compatible templates (`gtmpl-ng`).

`cook-docs` recursively scans directories (or explicit `.cook` file/directory targets), respects `.cookdocsignore`, parses Cooklang recipes via `cooklang-rs`, copies or WebP-converts companion images, enriches templates with emojis, gram weights, category tags, cross-links, and batch scaling, merges non-destructively into existing Markdown, syncs Zensical/MkDocs navigation trees, watches for live edits, and validates projects via `cook-docs doctor`.

---

## Overview & Mode of Operation

- Scans `--recipe-search-root` (default `.`) recursively for `*.cook` files (or renders positional `[FILES]...` mirrored relative to `recipe_search_root`), ignoring `.git` directories and patterns matching `.cookdocsignore`.
- Resolves companion images (`<Recipe Name>.webp`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png` in priority order) and optionally copies or converts them (`--assets-dir`, `--image-ext-map`, `--convert-images webp`, `--image-quality`).
- Generates slugified lowercase hyphenated `.md` files (e.g., `My Test Recipe.cook` -> `my-test-recipe.md`) either alongside each recipe or mirrored under `--output-dir`.
- Supports `--dry-run` (prints rendered Markdown and planned `--nav-file` changes to stdout without writing files) and `--jsonify` (prints parsed recipe JSON object or array to stdout).
- Uses serial execution for `--dry-run` and multi-threaded rendering across worker threads for disk output, followed by single-pass `--nav-file` synchronization.

---

## Architecture & Repository Layout

### Directory Structure

```text
cook-docs/
├── Cargo.toml                  # Rust Edition 2024 manifest
├── build.rs                    # Injects PROJECT_VERSION from git describe / Cargo version
├── Taskfile.yaml               # go-task automation (test, fmt, lint, completions, man, dist, release)
├── pyproject.toml              # Zensical docs Python deps (managed with uv)
├── zensical.toml               # Zensical static site config
├── assets/
│   ├── config.example.toml     # Fully documented example configuration
│   └── cook-docs.1             # Generated UNIX roff man page
├── completions/                # Generated bash, zsh, fish, powershell, elvish completions
├── src/
│   ├── main.rs                 # CLI entrypoint, logger init, subcommand dispatch
│   ├── lib.rs                  # Public library root & batch render orchestration
│   ├── config.rs               # clap CLI, figment TOML/YAML/JSON config & COOK_DOCS_* env precedence
│   ├── cook.rs                 # Recipe discovery, path/image slugs, category tags, aggregation & parsing
│   ├── document.rs             # gtmpl-ng built-ins, template helpers, Markdown formatting & asset copy/WebP
│   ├── enrichment.rs           # Emoji mappings, ingredient weight/density conversions & recipe link index
│   ├── merge.rs                # Non-destructive Markdown merge (markers & structure-aware)
│   ├── nav.rs                  # Format-preserving Zensical (zensical.toml) & MkDocs (mkdocs.yml) nav sync
│   ├── doctor.rs               # Project & recipe diagnostics (--check-recipes, --only, --strict, --json)
│   ├── watch.rs                # Debounced filesystem watcher for recipes & templates
│   ├── update.rs               # GitHub release self-updater (self-update / update)
│   └── types.rs                # Serializable Config, Recipe, Info, Step, Ingredient, Cookware, Timer
├── tests/
│   ├── integration_tests.rs    # Unit & integration tests
│   └── regression_tests.rs     # End-to-end CLI regression suite
├── testdata/                   # Sample .cook recipe, image, and .gotmpl template
└── docs/                       # Zensical documentation site sources
```

### Technology Stack

- **Language:** Rust (Edition 2024)
- **CLI & Config:** `clap` v4 (`derive`, `env`), `clap_complete`, `clap_mangen`, `figment` (`toml`, `yaml`, `json`, `env`)
- **Parsing & Templates:** `cooklang`, `gtmpl-ng`, `toml_edit`, `serde`, `serde_json`
- **Discovery, Watching & Updates:** `ignore`, `walkdir`, `notify`, `self_update`, `log`, `env_logger`
- **Docs & Automation:** `zensical` (via `uv`), `go-task` (`Taskfile.yaml`), `rumdl`, `yamllint-rs`, `taplo`, `typos`

---

## Installation & Building

### Package Managers

```bash
# Homebrew (macOS / Linux)
brew install nicholaswilde/tap/cook-docs

# APT (Debian / Ubuntu via nicholaswilde/apt)
sudo apt update && sudo apt install cook-docs
```

```powershell
# Scoop (Windows)
scoop bucket add nicholaswilde https://github.com/nicholaswilde/scoop-bucket.git
scoop install nicholaswilde/cook-docs
```

### Build or Install from Source

```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/nicholaswilde/cook-docs
# Or build locally (binary at target/release/cook-docs):
cargo build --release
```

## CLI Commands, Options, Config Files & Environment Variables

Precedence order (highest to lowest): **CLI Flags** > **Environment Variables (`COOK_DOCS_*`)** > **Config File** > **Defaults**.

### Subcommands

- `cook-docs [OPTIONS] [FILES]...`: Render discovered or targeted `.cook` recipes.
- `cook-docs watch [--debounce MS]` (or `cook-docs --watch`): Watch recipes/templates and re-render affected files on save.
- `cook-docs doctor` (alias `doc`): Validate configuration, inputs, templates, nav file, and permissions; pass `--check-recipes`, `--only <syntax,images,metadata,emojis,ignored>`, `--strict`, and/or `--json`.
- `cook-docs self-update` (alias `update`): Check (`--check`), install (`-y/--yes`), or pin (`--version <TAG>`) GitHub releases.
- `cook-docs completions <bash|zsh|fish|powershell|elvish>`: Print shell autocompletion script.
- `cook-docs man`: Print UNIX roff man page.

### Supported Parameters

| CLI Flag | Env Var | Config Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-C, --config <PATH>` | `COOK_DOCS_CONFIG` | N/A | N/A | Explicit config file (TOML, YAML, or JSON) |
| `-d, --dry-run` | `COOK_DOCS_DRY_RUN` | `dry_run` | `false` | Print Markdown & planned nav changes without writing |
| `-j, --jsonify` | `COOK_DOCS_JSONIFY` | `jsonify` | `false` | Print parsed recipe JSON to stdout |
| `-c, --recipe-search-root <DIR>` | `COOK_DOCS_RECIPE_SEARCH_ROOT` | `recipe_search_root` | `"."` | Base directory for recursive discovery & mirrored output |
| `-i, --ignore-file <FILE>` | `COOK_DOCS_IGNORE_FILE` | `ignore_file` | `".cookdocsignore"` | Ignore filename (`.gitignore` syntax) |
| `-o, --output-dir <DIR>` | `COOK_DOCS_OUTPUT_DIR` | `output_dir` | `""` | Custom output root mirroring relative subdirs |
| `--assets-dir <DIR>` | `COOK_DOCS_ASSETS_DIR` | `assets_dir` | `""` | Copy companion images (slug-named) into directory |
| `--image-ext <EXT>` | `COOK_DOCS_IMAGE_EXT` | `image_ext` | `""` | Unconditional extension override for `Info.ImageSlug` |
| `--image-ext-map <PAIRS>` | `COOK_DOCS_IMAGE_EXT_MAP` | `image_ext_map` | `{}` | Per-extension `src=dst` map for `Info.ImageSlug` (e.g. `jpg=webp,jpeg=webp`) |
| `--convert-images <FORMAT>` | `COOK_DOCS_CONVERT_IMAGES` | `convert_images` | `""` | Convert matching assets on copy (`webp` via `cwebp`; `.png`/`.webp` kept) |
| `--image-quality <1-100>` | `COOK_DOCS_IMAGE_QUALITY` | `image_quality` | `80` | Quality setting for `--convert-images` |
| `--emoji-file <PATH>` | `COOK_DOCS_EMOJI_FILE` | `emoji_file` | `""` | YAML/TOML/JSON ingredient, cookware, title, and category emoji mappings |
| N/A | N/A | `emoji` | N/A | Inline emoji mappings in `.cookdocs.{toml,yaml,json}` |
| `--weights-file <PATH>` | `COOK_DOCS_WEIGHTS_FILE` | `weights_file` | `""` | YAML/TOML/JSON ingredient density table for `toGrams` (supports `exclude`, `exclude_small_units`, `exclude_small_units_except`) |
| `--link-dirs <DIRS>` | `COOK_DOCS_LINK_DIRS` | `link_dirs` | `[]` | Comma-separated recipe subdirs eligible for `linkRecipe` cross-linking |
| `--link-in-steps` | `COOK_DOCS_LINK_IN_STEPS` | `link_in_steps` | `false` | Cross-link AST `@ingredient` spans inside step directions |
| N/A | N/A | `category_tags` | `{}` | Category path -> default tag lists (`Info.DefaultTags` / `Info.Tags`) |
| `--required-metadata <KEYS>` | `COOK_DOCS_REQUIRED_METADATA` | `required_metadata` | `[]` | Required metadata keys for `doctor --check-recipes` |
| `--ignored-ingredients-file <PATH>` | `COOK_DOCS_IGNORED_INGREDIENTS_FILE` | `ignored_ingredients_file` | `""` | Ingredients warned on when tagged with `@` in `doctor` |
| N/A | `COOK_DOCS_IGNORED_INGREDIENTS` | `ignored_ingredients` | `[]` | Inline list of ignored ingredients (merged with file) |
| `--nav-file <PATH>` | `COOK_DOCS_NAV_FILE` | `nav_file` | `""` | Zensical (`zensical.toml`) or MkDocs (`mkdocs.yml`) nav file to sync |
| `--merge` | `COOK_DOCS_MERGE` | `merge` | `false` | Non-destructively merge into existing Markdown files |
| `--force` | `COOK_DOCS_FORCE` | N/A | `false` | Force full overwrite even when `merge = true` |
| `-t, --template-files <PATHS>` | `COOK_DOCS_TEMPLATE_FILES` | `template_files` | `["recipe.md.gotmpl"]` | Comma-separated Go template paths |
| `-w, --word-wrap <N>` | `COOK_DOCS_WORD_WRAP` | `word_wrap` | `120` | Word-wrap column width for recipe steps |
| `-l, --log-level <LEVEL>` | `COOK_DOCS_LOG_LEVEL` | `log_level` | `"info"` | Log level (`trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn`/`warning`, `error`) |

### Config File Discovery Order

Auto-discovered (unless `-C/--config` or `COOK_DOCS_CONFIG` is given) in order: `/etc/cook-docs/`, `~/.config/`, `./` for `.cookdocs.toml`, `.cookdocs.yaml`, `.cookdocs.yml`, or `.cookdocs.json`. Keys accept `snake_case`, `kebab-case`, and `camelCase`.

---

## Merge Mode, Navigation Sync, Watch & Doctor

- **Non-Destructive Merge (`--merge` / `--force`)**: Replaces content inside `<!-- cook-docs:begin -->` ... `<!-- cook-docs:end -->` markers when present; otherwise performs structure-aware merge preserving YAML frontmatter keys/tags, H1 emojis, manual images (dropping orphaned reference links), custom `##` sections, tabs, `## Source` bullets, admonitions, Mermaid blocks, and footnotes.
- **Navigation Sync (`--nav-file`)**: Updates Zensical `zensical.toml` (`[[project.nav]]` or `[project] nav = [...]`) via `toml_edit` and MkDocs `mkdocs.yml`/`mkdocs.yaml` (`nav:`) while preserving comments, formatting, and YAML tags (`!!python/name:...`). Matches most-specific category/subcategory, preserves nested sub-sections and `index.md`, deduplicates entries, sorts leaves alphabetically, and respects `--dry-run`.
- **Watch Mode (`cook-docs watch`)**: Debounces `.cook` and template edits (`--debounce`, default `300ms`), re-renders only affected recipes, and syncs `--nav-file` automatically.
- **Doctor (`cook-docs doctor`)**: Checks config validity, search root, ignore file, templates, output writability, emoji/weights/ignored/nav files, `cwebp` availability, and (with `--check-recipes` / `--only`) recipe syntax, companion images, required metadata, unmapped emojis, and ignored `@` ingredients.

---

## Templating System (`gtmpl-ng`)

### Template Resolution Rules

- Bare filenames (e.g., `recipe.md.gotmpl`) resolve from the recipe's directory upward to `--recipe-search-root` (inclusive), falling back to the built-in default template.
- Paths starting with `.` or containing a separator resolve relative to `--recipe-search-root` (or directly if absolute).

### Built-in Named Templates

- **Sections:** `cook.headerSection`, `cook.imageSection`, `cook.lazyImageSection`, `cook.tableSection`, `cook.ingredientsSection`, `cook.cookwareSection` (auto-omitted when empty), `cook.stepsSection`, `cook.stepsWithQuotedCommentsSection`, `cook.stepsWithAdmonishedCommentsSection`, `cook.sourceSection`, `cook.commentsSection`, `cook.metadataSection`.
- **Components:** `cook.ingredientsHeader`, `cook.ingredients`, `cook.cookwareHeader`, `cook.cookware`, `cook.stepsHeader`, `cook.steps`, `cook.stepsWithQuotedCommentsHeader`, `cook.stepsWithQuotedComments`, `cook.stepsWithAdmonishedCommentsHeader`, `cook.stepsWithAdmonishedComments`, `cook.sourceHeader`, `cook.source`, `cook.metadataHeader`, `cook.metadata`, `cook.commentsHeader`, `cook.comments`.

### Registered Template Functions

`getSource`, `sumTimers`, `totalTime`, `toYaml`, `emoji`, `ingredientEmoji`, `cookwareEmoji`, `titleEmoji`, `toGrams`, `linkRecipe`, `scale`, `lower`, `replace`, `round`, `add1`, `wrap`, `indent`.

---

## Recipe Data Model & JSON Output

`cook-docs --jsonify` outputs `Recipe` (`Steps`, `Ingredients`, `Cookware`, `Metadata`, `Frontmatter`, `Config`, `Info`):

- **`Info`**: `RecipeName`, `RecipeSlug`, `RecipeFilePath`, `NewRecipeFilePath`, `ImageFileName`, `ImageFilePath`, `ImageSlug`, `RelRoot`, `Categories`, `DefaultTags`, `Tags`.
- **`Ingredients` / `Cookware`**: Aggregated and deduplicated recipe-wide lists alongside per-step `Steps[*].Ingredients`, `Steps[*].Cookware`, `Steps[*].Timers`, `Steps[*].Directions`, and `Steps[*].Comments`.
- **`Metadata` / `Frontmatter`**: Flat string map (`Metadata`) plus typed YAML/Cooklang frontmatter (`Frontmatter`).

---

## Development, Testing & Quality Gates

```bash
task fmt          # Format Rust code (cargo fmt --all)
task lint         # Run yamllint-rs and cargo clippy (-D warnings)
task lint:md      # Lint Markdown files with rumdl
task spellcheck   # Run typos spellcheck
task test         # Run fmt:check, lint, and cargo test
task completions  # Regenerate shell completion scripts under completions/
task man          # Regenerate UNIX man page at assets/cook-docs.1
task coverage     # Run cargo llvm-cov summary
task serve        # Serve Zensical docs locally via uv run
task dist         # Build release binary
task build-all    # Cross-compile Linux, macOS, and Windows targets
task release      # Bump version, validate, tag, and push release
```
